purpose.zh: 拉伸大腿内侧和腿后侧
purpose.en: Stretch the inner thigh and hamstrings.

text.zh: 膝盖伸直，腿慢慢向外侧落下
text.en: Keep your knee straight and lower the leg slowly out to the side

text.zh: 弹力带套住脚掌，用手握住承担腿的重量
text.en: Loop the band around your foot and hold it to take the leg’s weight.

text.zh: 另一条腿贴地，骨盆保持平稳
text.en: Keep the other leg long on the mat and your pelvis level.

commonErrors.en: Letting the pelvis roll to the side.

cautions.zh: 只拉到舒适的程度，腹股沟刺痛就停止
cautions.en: Stretch only to a comfortable point, and stop if your groin feels sharp pain.
